# Public Campaign Images

This repository stores campaign images used in email marketing campaigns.

## Structure

Images are organized in dated folders:
- `campaign_images_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS/` - Each upload creates a timestamped folder

## Usage

Images are automatically uploaded from campaign content extraction workflow and are referenced via GitHub URLs in campaign spreadsheets.

## Image URLs

Images can be accessed via GitHub blob URLs:
```
https://github.com/[username]/[repo]/blob/[branch]/campaign_images_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS/image_name.jpg
```
